title: Beefless Borscht
description: A hearty, vegan take on the traditional Eastern European beet soup, using mushrooms for a meaty twist.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the beets, carrots, onions, and garlic. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, and vinegar (if using). Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Stir in the ketchup. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill or chives (optional).
